start: ^I directed the overall level design and visual art direction, bridging the gap between our mechanics and the game world.
^Want to see how we built and stylized our levels?
technical_detail: ^For the layout, I guided the level design team by grayboxing blockouts that deliberately introduced and tested each gun’s specific color abilities before ramping up the difficulty.

^For the art design, our goal was to create an incredibly colorful experience. I pitched combining a dynamic Splatoon-style paint mechanic with a cute, cardboard-textured world aesthetic to give the environment a charming personality.
^And we made the characters cats because cats = cute!
